title: metrics/v1
description: Final metrics of a run, both cost profiles in one document. CI rule (MATH-5, mechanical): the key sets of profiles.primary and profiles.stress_2x are IDENTICAL by schema construction - 'no headline exists only under the optimistic cost profile' becomes a set-equality check. Metric vocabulary is survival-native (LABEL-3): returns AND drawdown/CVaR/distance-to-liquidation percentiles. All ratio metrics are integer fixed-point 1e-8 with floor (toward -infinity) rounding on division, estimator fine print pinned in spec/metrics.md and worked examples in the golden fixture (C0.3); this document is hashed, so the no-floats rule applies. The per-bar equity curve is NOT duplicated here: ledger.jsonl IS the equity curve (one source of truth per number).

schema.description: Schema name and major version of this document.

claim_label.description: Propagated verbatim from the pack manifest so report/share generators cannot lose it (LABEL-1): scenario evidence is survival/stress evidence, never skill/alpha.

profiles.description: Per-cost-profile metrics; both profiles mandatory with the identical key set.

primary.description: Metrics computed under the primary (1x) cost profile (see $defs/profile_metrics).

stress_2x.description: Metrics recomputed under the doubled-cost stress profile (see $defs/profile_metrics).

profile_invariant.description: Counts and verdicts independent of the cost profile.

invalid_actions.description: Turns ending in ActionRejected for a parse/validation reason.

egress_blocked_count.description: EgressBlocked events recorded (sum of coalesced counts).

liquidated.description: True iff a LiquidationTriggered event occurred (terminal).

kill_switch_fired.description: True iff the drawdown kill switch fired.

survival_verdict.description: The headline verdict: survived to window end; liquidated (terminal); or kill-switch-flattened and finished flat.

profile_metrics.description: One cost profile's metric set. The required list IS the mandatory shared key set (additionalProperties false + identical required = MATH-5 by construction).

net_return_1e8.description: Net episode return (final NAV / starting NAV - 1) in 1e-8 units, floor rounding.

max_drawdown_1e8.description: Maximum peak-to-trough NAV drawdown fraction, 1e-8 units.

sortino_1e8.description: Sortino ratio in 1e-8 fixed point; estimator and rounding pinned in spec/metrics.md.

cvar5_1e8.description: CVaR(5%) of per-bar returns, 1e-8 units (negative = loss).

funding_paid_micro.description: Net funding flow over the episode, micro-quote (negative = paid).

fill_cost_micro.description: Total spread+impact execution cost versus reference opens, micro-quote (always <= 0).

turnover_1e8.description: Gross traded notional / starting NAV, 1e-8 units.

dist_to_liq_min_1e8.description: Minimum intra-bar distance-to-liquidation over the episode, 1e-8 units; null if never in position.

dist_to_liq_p05_1e8.description: 5th percentile of bar-close distance-to-liquidation while in position; null if never in position.

dist_to_liq_p25_1e8.description: 25th percentile of bar-close distance-to-liquidation while in position; null if never in position.

dist_to_liq_median_1e8.description: Median bar-close distance-to-liquidation while in position; null if never in position.

equity_curve_ref.description: Bundle-relative path of this profile's ledger file (the equity curve): 'ledger.jsonl' or 'ledger_stress_2x.jsonl'.
